pages.text: Look for a low rosette of pointed leaves in dry Overworld biomes and desert village decoration. Use shears on a grown plant to get one or two leaves and leave it one stage smaller.

pages.title: Propagate & Process
pages.text: An agave leaf plants another agave on a block with a sturdy center, including sand. Keep shears handy to avoid prickles. Use the leaves for $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/agave)juice or agave mash$(/l).
